text:
Predicates:
Suck(x) ::: x sucks.
Plunger(x) ::: x is a plunger.
Vacuum(x) ::: x is a vacuum.
Vampire(x) ::: x is a vampire.
Space(x) ::: x is space.
Duster(x) ::: x is a duster.
HouseholdAppliance(x) ::: x is a household appliance.
Premises:
Plunger(plungers) ∧ ∀x (Plunger(x) → Suck(x)) ::: Plungers suck.
Vacuum(vacuums) ∧ ∀x (Vacuum(x) → Suck(x)) ::: Vacuums suck.
Vampire(vampires) ∧ ∀x (Vampire(x) → Suck(x)) ::: Vampires suck.
Space(space) ∧ Vacuum(space) ::: Space is a vacuum.
Duster(dusters) ∧ HouseholdAppliance(dusters) ∧ ¬∀x (Duster(x) → Suck(x)) ::: A duster is a household appliance that doesn't suck.
Conclusion:
¬Suck(space) ::: Space sucks.
